enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed with eyes closed. Turns from back to side. Pulls the duvet up to the shoulder. Remains still. Rolls onto the other side. Extends an arm toward the nightstand. Pulls the duvet back over the legs. Continues lying still with eyes closed. Shifts head on the pillow. Sleeps until the alarm sounds at 07:45.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Sits up on the edge of the bed. Stands up. Walks to the bathroom. Opens the bathroom door. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the tap. Wets hands. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth with water from a cup. Spits into the sink. Turns off the tap. Opens the shower door. Turns on the water heater. Turns the shower tap to warm. Steps into the shower. Wets hair and body. Applies shampoo. Rubs scalp. Applies soap to the body. Rinses off. Turns off the shower tap. Steps out. Picks up a towel. Dries hair and body. Hangs the towel on the hook. Turns off the bathroom light. Walks out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out milk, bread, and eggs. Closes the refrigerator door. Places the items on the counter. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a plate and a mug. Puts them on the counter. Picks up a knife. Spreads butter on the bread. Places the bread on the plate. Fills the kettle with water. Places the kettle on its base. Presses the kettle switch on. Puts bread in the toaster. Presses the toaster lever down. Cracks an egg into a bowl. Whisk with a fork. Pours the egg into a pan and cooks it on the induction cooker. Turns the induction cooker off. Slides the egg onto the plate. Pours hot water into the mug. Adds coffee powder and milk. Stirs with a spoon. Carries the plate and mug to the table. Sits down. Eats the bread and egg with a fork. Drinks the coffee. Stands up. Carries the plate and mug to the sink. Rinses them. Places them in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing a morning stretching and mobility routine on the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the living room. Unrolls a yoga mat on the floor. Sits down on the mat. Extends both legs forward. Leans forward and reaches toward the toes. Holds the position. Sits up. Crosses the legs. Rotates the torso to the left. Rotates the torso to the right. Raises both arms overhead. Lowers the arms. Stands on hands and knees in a quadruped position. Arches the back up. Drops the back down. Extends one leg backward. Switches to the other leg. Sits back on the heels. Leans forward with arms extended. Rises back up. Stands up from the mat. Rolls the mat up. Places the mat against the wall.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming the floor and tidying up the living space
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the corner of the living room. Picks up the vacuum cleaner. Unwinds the power cord. Plugs the cord into the wall socket. Presses the power button. Pushes the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Pulls it back. Moves around the sofa. Lifts the cushions. Vacuum under the cushions. Puts the cushions back. Pushes the vacuum along the baseboards. Reaches under the coffee table with the nozzle. Pulls out a magazine and a pen from under the table. Presses the power button to stop the vacuum. Unplugs the cord. Winds the cord around the hook. Picks up the TV remote from the sofa. Places it on the coffee table. Stacks magazines on the shelf. Picks up a cup from the table. Carries it to the kitchen. Places the vacuum cleaner back in the corner.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the shops and buying groceries for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the entryway. Picks up the keys from the hook. Picks up a reusable shopping bag. Opens the front door. Steps outside. Closes and locks the door. Walks along the pavement toward the shops. Crosses the road at the crossing. Continues walking. Reaches the shop entrance. Pushes the door open. Picks up a shopping basket. Walks down the aisles. Picks up vegetables and places them in the basket. Picks up milk and eggs. Picks up a pack of chicken. Picks up rice. Places items in the basket. Walks to the checkout counter. Places the basket on the counter. Watches the cashier scan the items. Takes out a card. Taps the card on the payment terminal. Puts the card back in the wallet. Places the items into the reusable bag. Picks up the bag. Walks out of the shop. Walks back along the pavement. Reaches the front door. Unlocks the door. Steps inside. Closes the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking lunch on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Places the shopping bag on the counter. Takes out the vegetables, chicken, and eggs. Opens the refrigerator. Places the milk and eggs on the shelf. Closes the refrigerator. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a pot. Places the pot on the induction cooker. Turns the induction cooker on. Pours water into the pot. Picks up a knife and a cutting board. Places the vegetables on the board. Cuts the vegetables into pieces. Scrapes the pieces into the pot. Cuts the chicken into pieces. Places the chicken in the pot. Picks up a spoon. Stirs the pot. Picks up salt and pours it in. Places the lid on the pot. Turns the range hood on. Waits at the counter. Stirs again. Turns off the induction cooker. Turns off the range hood.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up a bowl from the cupboard. Picks up a ladle. Scoops the soup into the bowl. Carries the bowl to the table. Sits down on the chair. Picks up chopsticks. Eats the vegetables and chicken. Drinks the soup from the bowl. Stands up. Carries the bowl to the sink. Opens the dishwasher door. Places the bowl on the lower rack. Picks up the ladle and the spoon. Places them in the cutlery basket. Picks up the cutting board. Places it in the rack. Closes the dishwasher door. Presses the start button. Wipes the counter with a cloth. Rinses the cloth. Hangs the cloth on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading physiotherapy journals and reviewing continuing education material on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the study. Pulls out the chair. Sits down. Turns on the desk lamp. Presses the computer power button. Waits for the screen to load. Moves the mouse. Opens the web browser. Types a search for a physiotherapy journal. Clicks a link. Scrolls down the page. Picks up a notebook and a pen from the desk. Writes notes on the page. Scrolls further. Clicks another article. Reads the text on the screen. Highlights a sentence with the mouse. Opens a continuing education module. Watches a video segment. Pauses the video. Writes more notes. Types a summary into a document. Saves the document. Closes the browser. Leans back in the chair. Turns off the desk lamp. Stands up. Pushes the chair in.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching streaming shows on the TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the living room. Picks up the TV remote from the coffee table. Presses the power button. Waits for the screen to turn on. Presses the streaming app button. Scrolls through the show list. Selects a show. Presses play. Sits down on the sofa. Leans back. Watches the screen. Picks up a glass of water from the table. Drinks. Places the glass back. Adjusts the volume with the remote. Pauses the show. Presses play again. Changes the episode. Watches the next episode. Presses pause. Stands up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Going for a brisk afternoon walk and light exercise outdoors
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the entryway. Picks up the keys. Puts on shoes. Ties the laces. Opens the front door. Steps outside. Closes the door. Walks briskly along the path. Swings both arms. Walks to the park. Jogs slowly along the path. Stops at a bench. Places one foot on the bench. Leans forward over the leg. Switches legs. Steps down. Does ten squats. Stands up. Does ten lunges. Stretches both arms overhead. Walks to a low bar. Places both hands on the bar. Does five push-ups against the bar. Steps back. Walks around the park path. Walks back along the pavement. Reaches the front door. Unlocks the door. Steps inside. Closes the door. Takes off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing clothes after exercise
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the bathroom. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the water heater. Turns the shower tap on. Tests the water temperature with a hand. Steps into the shower. Wets the body. Applies soap. Rubs the arms, legs, and torso. Rinses off. Turns off the shower tap. Steps out of the shower. Picks up a towel. Dries the hair and body. Wraps the towel around the waist. Walks to the bedroom. Opens the wardrobe. Takes out a t-shirt and trousers. Puts them on. Puts the used clothes into the laundry basket. Walks back to the bathroom. Hangs the towel on the hook. Turns off the bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Practising rehabilitation exercise techniques and studying online courses on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the study. Pulls out the chair. Sits down. Turns on the desk lamp. Presses the computer power button. Moves the mouse. Opens an online course page. Clicks the lesson. Watches the video. Pauses the video. Stands up. Picks up a resistance band from the shelf. Holds the band with both hands. Raises both arms to shoulder height. Pulls the band apart. Releases. Repeats ten times. Wraps the band around a chair leg. Sits down. Pulls the band with one arm. Repeats with the other arm. Stands up. Picks up a small dumbbell. Curls the arm. Switches arms. Places the dumbbell down. Picks up a foam roller. Rolls the thigh on the floor. Places the roller back. Sits down at the desk. Types notes into a document. Saves the file. Closes the browser. Turns off the desk lamp. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and using the range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Opens the refrigerator. Takes out vegetables, tofu, and meat. Closes the refrigerator. Places the items on the counter. Opens the cupboard. Takes out a pan. Places the pan on the induction cooker. Turns the induction cooker on. Picks up the knife and cutting board. Cuts the vegetables. Cuts the meat into strips. Pours oil into the pan. Adds the meat. Stirs with a spatula. Adds the vegetables. Adds the tofu. Sprinkles salt. Pours soy sauce. Stirs again. Turns on the range hood. Places the lid on the pan. Waits. Opens the rice cooker. Scoops rice into two bowls. Turns off the induction cooker. Turns off the range hood. Carries the bowls to the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Pulls out the chair. Sits down at the table. Picks up chopsticks. Picks up a piece of meat. Eats the rice. Eats the vegetables. Drinks water from a glass. Picks up more rice with the chopsticks. Finishes the bowl. Stands up. Carries the bowl and plate to the sink. Rinses them under the tap. Opens the dishwasher. Places the bowl and plate inside. Closes the dishwasher. Wipes the table with a cloth. Wipes the counter. Hangs the cloth on the hook. Walks out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the living room. Picks up the TV remote. Presses the power button. Presses the streaming app button. Scrolls through the list. Selects a movie. Presses play. Sits down on the sofa. Leans back against the cushion. Watches the screen. Reaches for a glass of water on the coffee table. Drinks. Places the glass back. Stretches both arms. Adjusts the volume with the remote. Pulls a blanket over the legs. Watches the screen. Pauses the movie. Stands up. Walks to the kitchen. Returns with a snack. Sits down again. Presses play. Watches until the movie ends. Presses the power button on the remote.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing video games on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the game controller from the shelf. Presses the power button on the game console. Waits for the menu screen. Selects a game with the controller buttons. Presses start. Holds the controller with both hands. Presses the buttons. Tilts the controller. Leans forward on the sofa. Presses the trigger buttons. Pauses the game. Stands up. Walks to the kitchen. Returns with a glass of water. Sits down. Presses play. Continues playing. Finishes the level. Saves the game. Presses the power button on the console. Places the controller back on the shelf.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and running the washing machine for laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the bathroom. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the tap. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the bristles. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into the sink. Turns off the tap. Wipes the face with a towel. Hangs the towel on the hook. Opens the washing machine door. Picks up the laundry basket. Loads the clothes into the drum. Closes the door. Opens the detergent drawer. Pours detergent into the drawer. Closes the drawer. Presses the power button. Selects the wash program. Presses the start button. Turns off the bathroom light. Walks out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind down time, browsing on the phone and dimming the light
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the bedroom. Turns on the bedroom light. Picks up the phone from the nightstand. Sits down on the bed. Unlocks the phone with the thumb. Scrolls through the news feed. Taps on a video. Watches the screen. Scrolls further. Types a message. Sends the message. Places the phone on the nightstand. Stands up. Walks to the switch. Dims the bedroom light. Turns on the air conditioner with the remote. Sets the temperature. Walks back to the bed. Pulls back the duvet. Lies down on the bed. Picks up the phone again. Scrolls for a while. Places the phone on the nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Pulls the duvet up to the chest. Turns onto the right side. Adjusts the pillow under the head. Closes eyes. Remains still. Turns onto the left side. Pulls the duvet higher. Remains still with eyes closed. Breathes steadily. Sleeps through the night.
